ticker_news.title: Small-caps rally ignites options frenzy, but strategists urge caution By Reuters - Investing.com
ticker_news.description: The small-cap Russell 2000 index has rallied strongly in recent weeks, leading to a surge in bullish options trading. However, some strategists caution that the rally may be short-lived, as similar rotations have not had much traction in the past.
ticker_news.author: Reuters

ticker_news.title: Tesla shares could swing 10% either way after earnings, options show By Reuters - Investing.com Canada
ticker_news.description: Tesla shares are expected to swing around 10% in either direction after the company reports its Q2 earnings, based on options market data. The EV maker's margins are likely to hit a 5-year low, and CEO Elon Musk is expected to discuss the company's robotaxi plans and AI products.
ticker_news.author: Reuters
